_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id}, tii {num_rounds} ke akuen de Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Yin ee aret ${pool} bi ke yin lac keek yen Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Cɔɔl ke akuen: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Na ci keek yin lac → Yin ee aret $(pool - X), keek yen Player ee aret $X
  - Na ci keek yen lac → Keek ee aret $0
  - Alic de: [Offer: $3]  ku  'Aye yin lac keek yen cɔɔl. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Keek yen lac keek yen [Accept] ku [Reject]
  - Alic de: 'Ee lac keek yen cɔɔl. [Accept]'
            'Aye yin lac keek yen ci keek. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Akuen {round_number} ke lac keek yen! ---
Player {proposer_id} ee cɔɔl ke akuen, Player {responder_id} ee keek yen lac keek yen.
round.offer: Wär {round_number}: Kɛɛcök {proposer_id} wɛ̈t ${offer} ku Kɛɛcök {responder_id} (kɛn wɛ̈t ${keep}).
round.accepted: Kɛɛcök {responder_id} acë bɛ̈i! Wär {round_number} bɛ̈nyde: Kɛɛcök {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Kɛɛcök {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Wɛ̈t thïn: Kɛɛcök 0: ${total_0}, Kɛɛcök 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Kɛɛcök {responder_id} acë bɛ̈i! Wär {round_number} bɛ̈nyde: Kɛɛcök lɔ̈ɔ̈k +$0. Wɛ̈t thïn: Kɛɛcök 0: ${total_0}, Kɛɛcök 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Raan wïc bï ya looi adhil kë cï gäm ye gam në form [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Kä ye ke gäm adhil bï ya nambaa path.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kë cï gam adhil tɔ̈u në kaam de $0 ku ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Acïn kë ye yök ke bï kek ya gam.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Kɛɛcök aŋic kuɛ̈ɛ̈r bë kekë [Accept] kɛn [Reject] tɛk.

outcome.win: Player {winner} ee lac keek yen ${winner_total} ke yin lac keek yen Player {loser} ee lac keek yen ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Kɛ̈ɛ̈r! Kɔc kɛ̈ɛ̈r aaci looi ${total} yic.
